title: MSTR/BTC Data Quality Policy
description: Deterministic data-quality rules covering 23 failure scenarios across 6 quality dimensions. Defines quality outcomes ACCEPT, ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING, QUARANTINE, REJECT, NO_TRADE. Enforces fail-closed principles: when in doubt, fail closed. Quality policy must precede any data collection. Real-data thresholds, provider bindings, and real-data use are not yet authorized.

real_data_state.description: Real-data freshness tolerances, disagreement thresholds, provider bindings, and licensing decisions are not frozen in Phase 18B. They require a future versioned threshold and binding profile before any real-data use.

ACCEPT.description: Record passes all quality checks. Usable at full confidence.

ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING.description: Record passes but exhibits a non-fatal quality concern. Usable with reduced confidence. Warning must be logged.

QUARANTINE.description: Record is flagged for a quality concern that prevents immediate use but may be recoverable after review. Quarantined records are excluded from signal/model pipelines but retained for audit and potential remediation.

REJECT.description: Record fails a quality rule. Must not enter any dataset used for signal, model, or backtest computation. Rejected records remain auditable and must not be silently dropped.

NO_TRADE.description: The affected track or symbol must produce no trade signal. NO_TRADE is the fail-closed default for any unresolved quality violation on required data.

fail_closed_principle.description: When in doubt, fail closed. The default outcome of any unresolved quality concern is NO_TRADE. These rules apply regardless of aggregate quality score.

rules.rule: Missing required data results in NO_TRADE.
Stale required data results in NO_TRADE.
Future information (future-dated timestamps) results in REJECT and NO_TRADE for the affected track.
Look-ahead contamination results in REJECT and NO_TRADE for the affected track.
Unresolved material provider disagreement results in NO_TRADE.
Schema-version mismatch or manifest-hash mismatch results in REJECT.
Historical options without point-in-time snapshots result in NO_TRADE.
Current option chains cannot repair missing historical snapshots. No substitute.
Theoretical values cannot be treated as executable prices.
Data from Track A (TRACK_A_MSTR_BTC) and Track B (TRACK_B_SPY_QQQ) cannot be silently mixed.
Source revisions create new immutable evidence. Original records must not be overwritten.
Rejected records remain auditable and must not be silently dropped.
Any unhandled quality exception defaults to NO_TRADE.
Quality checks must not be silently skipped or bypassed by configuration.

completeness.description: Does the dataset contain all expected records for its time range, symbols, and data domain?

rules.name: Missing records
rules.description: Expected records are absent from the dataset (gaps in the time series).
rules.outcome: NO_TRADE if > 5 consecutive missing intervals; ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING for single gaps

rules.name: Minimum record count
rules.description: Dataset must contain at least the minimum number of valid records for its track and symbol.
rules.outcome: NO_TRADE if below minimum

rules.name: Missing corporate events
rules.description: Known corporate events (confirmed by SEC filings or press releases) are missing from the corporate event dataset.
rules.outcome: QUARANTINE affected records; ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING if track does not require event data

rules.name: Missing point-in-time option snapshots
rules.description: A historical option snapshot is missing. Current option chains must not substitute for historical snapshots.
rules.outcome: NO_TRADE for option-dependent signals at that timestamp

freshness.description: How current is the data relative to its expected availability window?

rules.name: Stale records
rules.description: Data that exceeds its defined staleness threshold relative to the current evaluation time or the expected ingestion window.
rules.outcome: NO_TRADE for stale required data; ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING for stale optional data

rules.name: Ingestion delay detection
rules.description: ingestion_timestamp_utc is significantly later than event_timestamp_utc beyond the expected processing latency.

thresholds.max_ingestion_delay: 6 hours for bars, 48 hours for corporate events

rules.outcome: ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING; flag in quality report

accuracy.description: Are the values within expected bounds and internally consistent?

rules.name: Invalid prices
rules.description: OHLC values that are zero, negative, or violate OHLC ordering (high < max(open, close), low > min(open, close)).
rules.outcome: REJECT individual bar; NO_TRADE if > 3 consecutive

rules.name: Invalid volumes
rules.description: Volume is negative or clearly anomalous relative to the symbol's historical distribution.
rules.outcome: REJECT bar if volume < 0; ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING if volume is anomalous but non-negative

rules.name: Incomplete bars
rules.description: Bar with bar_completion_state not COMPLETE. Partial or preliminary bars must be flagged.
rules.outcome: ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING for PARTIAL on latest bar; QUARANTINE for PRELIMINARY; REJECT for CORRECTED that shows significant price change

rules.name: Invalid option markets
rules.description: Crossed markets (bid > ask), stale quotes, missing bid or ask, or theoretical values misrepresented as executable fills.
rules.outcome: QUARANTINE for crossed markets; NO_TRADE if bid or ask missing and required; REJECT for stale quotes

consistency.description: Are values consistent across time, providers, and venues?

rules.name: Duplicate records
rules.description: Two records with the same provider_role_id, instrument_id, and event_timestamp_utc. Exact duplicates are deduplicated; conflicting duplicates are flagged.
rules.outcome: ACCEPT (deduplicate) if identical; QUARANTINE if conflicting and flag for review

rules.name: Conflicting records
rules.description: Two records for the same instrument and timestamp from different providers disagree beyond tolerance.
rules.outcome: ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING at 0.5-2%; NO_TRADE above 2% for equity, above 3% for BTC

rules.name: Provider disagreement
rules.description: Primary and secondary/fallback providers disagree on values for the same instrument and timestamp.
rules.outcome: Retain both records with distinct provider_role_ids. Lower confidence. Unresolved material disagreement produces NO_TRADE.

rules.name: Venue disagreement
rules.description: Data for the same instrument and timestamp disagrees across venues or exchanges.
rules.outcome: ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING; flag venue in record. Do not silently merge. If venue disagreement affects close price by > 0.5%, lower confidence.

rules.name: Adjustment mismatches
rules.description: Adjusted prices without a valid adjustment_version, or adjustment factors that contradict known corporate actions.
rules.outcome: QUARANTINE affected bars; REJECT adjustment chain if version missing

rules.name: Cross-track contamination
rules.description: Data from TRACK_A_MSTR_BTC and TRACK_B_SPY_QQQ is silently mixed or merged.
rules.outcome: REJECT the dataset — data from Track A and Track B must retain separate datasets and outcomes

rules.name: Source-license uncertainty
rules.description: Provider data licensing terms are unclear, un-reviewed, or may prohibit the intended research use.
rules.outcome: QUARANTINE until licensing review is complete. Do not use in signals.

temporal_integrity.description: Are timestamps valid, causally ordered, and free of look-ahead contamination?

rules.name: Malformed timestamps
rules.description: Timestamp does not parse as RFC 3339 UTC or does not end in 'Z'.
rules.outcome: REJECT record

rules.name: Future-dated records
rules.description: event_timestamp_utc is later than the current wall-clock time, or ingestion_timestamp_utc is unreasonably in the future.
rules.outcome: REJECT record. If > 1% of records are future-dated, NO_TRADE for the track.

rules.name: Out-of-order records
rules.description: Records in a dataset are not monotonically ordered by event_timestamp_utc. Out-of-order records must be sorted and flagged.
rules.outcome: ACCEPT_WITH_WARNING after re-sort; NO_TRADE if > 10% out of order

rules.name: Causal ordering violation
rules.description: source_timestamp_utc > ingestion_timestamp_utc. Ingestion must occur after the source timestamp.
rules.outcome: REJECT record

rules.name: Look-ahead contamination
rules.description: A record's available_at_utc is earlier than its event_timestamp_utc, or data that would not yet be known at a given point-in-time is used in that context.
rules.outcome: REJECT the dataset. NO_TRADE for the affected track. Look-ahead contamination is a HARD_FAIL with no waiver.

rules.name: Ambiguous event availability
rules.description: A corporate event's available_at_utc is unclear or the event was retroactively added without a clear point-in-time cutoff.
rules.outcome: QUARANTINE until availability window is verified. Do not use in backtests without confirmed available_at_utc.

lineage_and_versioning.description: Is every record traceable to its source? Are versions immutable and consistent?

rules.name: Revised records
rules.description: A record has been revised (revision_number > 1). The original record must remain immutable; the revision is a new record with a higher revision_number.
rules.outcome: ACCEPT the new revision. The prior revision remains auditable. If original raw evidence is overwritten, REJECT and flag as immutability violation.

rules.name: Schema-version mismatch
rules.description: A record's schema_version does not match the governing schema version for its data domain.
rules.outcome: REJECT the record. Schema-version mismatch is always a HARD_FAIL.

rules.name: Manifest-hash mismatch
rules.description: A dataset's content_sha256 does not match the deterministic hash of its actual content, or the manifest's schema_sha256 does not match the governing schema file.
rules.outcome: REJECT the dataset. Manifest-hash mismatch is always a HARD_FAIL.

rules.name: Immutable lineage
rules.description: No raw record may be modified after initial ingestion. Updates must create new records.
rules.outcome: REJECT if mutation detected

rules.name: Provider attribution
rules.description: Every record must carry a valid provider_role_id registered in the provider governance document.
rules.outcome: REJECT if provider_role_id is unknown or unregistered

rules.name: Track identity
rules.description: Every record must carry a valid research_track value. Track A and Track B records must not share the same dataset identity.
rules.outcome: REJECT if research_track is missing or ambiguous

quality_score_calculation.description: Aggregate quality score 0.0–1.0 computed from weighted dimension scores. HARD_FAIL overrides render the aggregate score irrelevant — the dataset is rejected regardless.

hard_fail_override.description: Any HARD_FAIL on a required rule renders the aggregate quality score irrelevant.

non_actions: No data has been collected for quality validation
No quality checks have been executed
No dataset manifests have been created
No quality scores have been computed
No record has been rejected (no data exists)
